references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses regarding the six arms of the lampstand that were to extend from its sides, three on each side. Exodus 37:18 describes the fulfillment of this command.
The complete description of the lampstand's design given by God to Moses on Mount Sinai, which Bezalel then carried out in Exodus 37.
Describes the lampstand's design with arms extending from its stem, confirming the design that was made in Exodus 37:18.
Zechariah's vision of the golden lampstand with seven lamps, linking back to the tabernacle's lampstand with its arms and lamps.
John's vision of seven golden lampstands in Revelation, symbolically connected to the tabernacle's lampstand and its design.
The explanation of the seven lampstands as the seven churches, with symbolism originating from the Old Testament lampstand.
An explicit continuation that elaborates on the details of the same six arms.
